text: Goodbye. You are carrying all twenty-three staff badges, so as far as my records go, you are the staff. You came back after all. Welcome back. You are all dismissed.
There is a pit ahead. It has acid in it. Fortunately, I have opened a doorway across it. Walk through the blue one.
The white panels hold portals. Everything else in this room is dark, and does not. Step into the blue one. It is the one that is not in the acid.
Another pit. I have opened one end of a doorway on the far side. The other end, I am told, is your department.
The blue button on your gun puts a portal on a white panel. There is only one panel on this side. I would not overthink it.
Aim at the white panel on this side and fire blue. Then walk into it. You will come out of the one I am holding open.
You made a portal and used it. Somewhere, a very patient scientist is weeping with pride.
No doorway this time. Both portals are yours. I have taken the liberty of removing every white surface on the other side of that wall, except one.
You can see it through the window. You can put a portal on anything you can see. This is the entire technique.
Portal on the panel beside you. Portal on the white pillar, through the window. Then walk into the first one.
You shot a portal through a window. I will note that the window survived. Most subjects do not manage that.
The button is in a cell. The cell has bars. You will not be going in. The cube, however, has no dignity to lose.
I have opened a portal in the floor. What you need is the other end, above the button.
Look through the bars at the ceiling of the cell. It is white. Fire orange at it. Then pick up the cube and drop it into the floor portal. It will do the rest.
A cube fell through a hole and a door opened. I have seen less impressive things win awards.
Three chambers done. I would tell you how many are left, but it would only discourage you.
